name: Vaultwarden
description: Lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server for securely storing and syncing credentials across devices.

env.label: Admin Token
env.description: Token for accessing the Vaultwarden admin panel at /admin

env.label: Allow Signups
env.description: Whether new users can register accounts

env.label: Domain URL
env.description: Full URL where Vaultwarden is accessible (e.g. https://vault.example.com). Required for email and WebSocket features.

env.label: Allow Invitations
env.description: Whether existing users can invite new users even when signups are disabled

env.label: Enable WebSocket
env.description: Enable WebSocket notifications for real-time sync between clients

env.label: Allow Sends
env.description: Whether users can use the Bitwarden Send feature to share secrets

env.label: Show Password Hint
env.description: Whether to show password hints on the login page
